# ScanDot

[![CI](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

ScanDot is an experimental Android app for capturing and viewing 3D point clouds on a supported phone. It combines ARCore camera tracking and depth estimates, saves scans locally, and provides an interactive viewer.

The repository also contains a separate video photogrammetry pipeline that runs on a workstation using FFmpeg and COLMAP. **The Android app does not reconstruct ordinary video with photogrammetry on the phone.**

## Current status

- Capture, save and reopen point clouds on devices that support ARCore Depth.
- Rotate, pan and zoom scans in the viewer. An optional full-depth mode interpolates missing depth and can distort surfaces.
- Prepare video frames and run a sparse or dense COLMAP reconstruction on a workstation.

This is an early prototype. Results can contain gaps, drift and noise; they are not textured meshes or validated measurements. Reflective, transparent and textureless subjects are difficult. Capture quality and device compatibility need further testing.

## Try the preview

Download the [preview APK](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/releases/tag/v0.3.0-preview.1). The release notes describe compatibility and signing limitations.

## Build the Android app

You need JDK 17, Android SDK 36, and an Android device with ARCore Depth support. Camera permission is required; Google Play Services for AR may require installation or an update.

```sh
cd android-app
./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug testDebugUnitTest
```

On Windows, use `gradlew.bat` in place of `./gradlew`. The debug APK is written to `android-app/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Install it as an update to preserve existing app data.

In the app, name the scan, tap **Start scan**, and move slowly around the subject in good light. Save it, then open it from **Results**. Scans are stored in the app's private storage; uninstalling the app removes them.

## Workstation video pipeline

The benchmark requires Python 3.12 or newer, FFmpeg, FFprobe and a compatible COLMAP installation. Dense reconstruction requires a compatible COLMAP configuration. From the repository root:

```sh
python -m processing.benchmark prepare "path/to/input.mp4" --output "path/to/new-run" --fps 5
python -m processing.benchmark reconstruct "path/to/new-run" --colmap "path/to/colmap" --dense
```

The output directory must not already exist. Omit `--dense` for a sparse-only run. See the subcommand `--help` output for options. A successful run does not establish complete or accurate geometry.

The Python tests use the standard library:

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

## Project structure

```text
android-app/  Android capture, local storage and point-cloud viewer
processing/   Video preparation and COLMAP orchestration
tests/        Python tests with synthetic fixtures
tools/        Workstation utilities…

quer3q/kraken-mount.content: A PS5 game mounter. It finds games on the internal SSD, the M.2 drive and USB drives. **Supported formats**: debug FPKG (`.pkg`) and game folders (plain, or packed with zstd or LZ4). For large, demanding games, use the zstd pack format: it performs better than FPKG. ## How to 1. Download `kraken-mount.elf` from [Releases](https://github.com/quer3q/kraken-mount/releases) and send it to your jailbroken PS5 with the ELF loader (elfldr, port 9021) or payload-manager: `nc -w 3 9021 < kraken-mount.elf`. kstuff must be loaded, and ShadowMount+ must not be running: Kraken Mount waits until both are true. 2. Put each game in a scan root: - internal SSD: `/data/homebrew`, `/data/etaHEN/games` - M.2 or extended drive (`/mnt/ext0`, `/mnt/ext1`): `homebrew`, `etaHEN/games` or the drive root - USB drive (`/mnt/usb0` to `/mnt/usb7`): `homebrew`, `etaHEN/games` or the drive root 3. Each game gets a " registered" notification and its own home-screen tile. [ampr-emu-ng](https://github.com/quer3q/ampr-emu-ng) comes bundled and is installed into `/data/krakenmount/ampr/` at start. To run another build, put its `libSceAmpr.sprx` there; it is kept until you delete it. A game that needs the DLC or PlayGo emulator and ships none gets the bundled one in its fakelib (setting `add_emulators`, on by default); a game's own copy is kept, unless it is a known older release of the bundled one, which is upgraded. Details: [DLC emulator](docs/dlcemu.md), [PlayGo stub](docs/playgo.md). Caches live in `/data/krakenmount/caches/`, settings in `/data/krakenmount/config.toml` and the log in `/data/krakenmount/kraken.log`. To build it yourself: `ps5/build.sh` (needs Docker), output `target/ps5/kraken-mount.elf`. ## Thanks - [drakmor/ShadowMountPlus](https://github.com/drakmor/ShadowMountPlus): home-screen registration, the fakelib sandbox overlay and backports are ported from it. - [drakmor/dlc_emu](https://github.com/drakmor/dlc_emu): the bundled DLC emulator (`libSceAppContent.sprx`, `libSceNpEntitlementAccess.sprx`, `libSceGameUpdate.sprx`), added to a game's fakelib when the game has a `dlc_emu.ini` at its root; a known older release the game ships is upgraded, any other copy is kept. - [drakmor/pgo_stub](https://github.com/drakmor/pgo_stub): the bundled PlayGo stub (`libScePlayGo.sprx`), added to a game's fakelib when its `eboot.bin` imports `libScePlayGo` and the game ships none. - [ps5-payload-sdk](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/sdk): the PS5 toolchain. ## License GPL-3.0-or-later (`LICENSE`). Third-party notices are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`.

# 揪咪 Jiumi 一款轻量的 Android 应用行为监测与管理工具。
无需 Root，也无需电脑，记录保存在本机。 **[下载 APK](https://github.com/ybblab/Jiumi/releases/latest)** · [使用指南](https://jiumi.ybblab.com/download/) · [官网](https://jiumi.ybblab.com) · [English](README.en.md) Android 11 及以上 · 安装包约 4 MB · Apache 2.0
## 界面速览

     

## 功能 | 功能 | 可以看到或做到什么 | | --- | --- | | 行为记录 | 按时间、应用或类型查看位置、剪贴板、设备标识等 **12 类数据、56 种访问**，也可以筛选后台记录。 | | 需要关注 | 集中查看后台发送数据、后台读取敏感数据、短时间内频繁访问和反复被拒的尝试。 | | 网络活动 | 按应用查看连接地址和可用的流量统计。开启域名记录后，可显示关联到的域名。 | | 系统历史 | 在应用详情查看 Android 保留的权限访问明细和累计次数，包括开始监测前的部分行为。 | | 日志导出 | 在「设置 › 导出日志」将选定时段的记录导出为包含 CSV 的 ZIP，供保存和分析。 | | 通知 | 监测时常驻一条精简通知，显示已监测时长并带停止按钮，可在「设置 › 通知」关闭。可选显示这次监测的应用数和记录数；开启「需要关注提醒」后，应用新出现需要关注的行为时会通知你，同一次监测里同一应用的同一项只提醒一次。 | ## 管理应用 「应用」页按来源整理应用。在应用详情里查看行为记录，再决定要不要改动。所有管理操作都由你发起，揪咪改动后会读回系统状态确认是否生效，系统拒绝时显示原因。

   

| 操作 | 会发生什么 | | --- | --- | | 权限管理 | 在应用详情的「权限管理」里逐项关闭或开启权限。「可控权限总开关」一次关闭全部，再打开时只恢复揪咪关闭过的权限。系统锁定的权限标为只读。 | | 联网管理 | 在支持的设备上，通过 Android 自带的防火墙为单个应用关闭或恢复联网，不占用 VPN。应用与其他应用共用 UID、规则由其他工具设置，或无法确认只影响这一个应用时，开关会锁定并说明原因。 | | 冻结与解冻 | 冻结会让 Android 为当前用户停用这个应用并保留数据，可在「应用 › 已冻结」解冻。已冻结的应用图标带雪花标记。 | | 冻结失效 | 揪咪冻结过的应用如果又被启用，列表和详情会标为「冻结已失效」，时间线记下发现的时间；无法得知是谁启用的。开启「设置 › 应用管理 › 冻结失效时自动重新冻结」后，会再冻结一次。 | | 删除自己安装的应用 | 输入完整包名确认后，揪咪先备份安装包再卸载。之后可在「应用 › 已删除」尝试装回。**应用数据会随卸载删除，备份只能恢复安装包。** | | 移除预装应用 | 在「设置 › 应用管理」开启后，可为当前用户移除受支持的预装应用。系统中的原件和应用数据会保留，可在「应用 › 已删除」尝试恢复。 | 「设置 › 应用管理」的「执行身份」显示这些操作以谁的身份执行。使用 Root，或以 Root 启动的 Shizuku 时，冻结、解冻、为当前用户删除和恢复以 Root 身份执行，能更改手机不允许 shell 更改的系统应用；使用无线调试时以 shell 身份执行，部分系统应用手机不允许更改，揪咪会说明原因。卸载自己安装的应用只影响当前用户，工作资料或分身里的同一应用会保留。 核心系统组件默认受保护。改动手机依赖的组件可能影响系统功能，揪咪会在操作前提示风险。 ## 不用 Root，怎么看到后台？ Android 在应用运行时会产生权限访问记录、连接表、系统跟踪和事件日志。揪咪探针以 **shell 身份**读取可用的系统信号，App 再按规则整理成记录，存入手机上的数据库。监测过程不会向其他应用注入代码。冻结、删除、关闭权限和联网等操作需要你在应用管理中主动发起。

# Willow · 柳 **An open-source desktop dashboard for AI coding usage.** Track tokens, estimated costs, and sessions for OpenAI Codex CLI, Claude Code, Kimi CLI, and other coding agents. Willow reads usage logs on your device. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Windows-lightgrey) ![Tauri](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tauri-v2-24C8DB?logo=tauri&logoColor=white) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-61DAFB?logo=react&logoColor=white) **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Download for Windows x64](https://github.com/hey-pu/Willow/releases/latest) · [Build on macOS](#install-and-build)
## What is Willow? Willow brings local usage logs from multiple AI coding tools into one desktop app. Compare input, output, and cache tokens, see estimated costs by day or model, and look up individual sessions. Open the quick panel from the Windows system tray or the macOS menu bar. Reports reflect the usage recorded on your device. Cost estimates use model prices. Check your provider's dashboard for official billing and subscription limits. Willow stores usage data locally in SQLite and can refresh its pricing data online. ![Willow showing AI token usage, estimated costs, and model breakdowns using demo data](docs/screenshots/overview.png) ## Features - **Multi-agent**: Claude Code, Codex CLI and Kimi CLI out of the box, with an adapter architecture ready for more - **Cost estimates**: long-context pricing (the whole request above 200K/272K/512K, as vendors bill it), 5m/1h cache-write pricing, cache-read discounts, fast/priority tier rates, dated list-price changes, DeepSeek off-peak rates — and stored estimates are recalculated when prices change - **Menu bar ticker**: today's cost or token count right next to the clock - **5-hour billing blocks**: each agent's usage grouped into hour-aligned 5-hour windows (Claude's and Codex's usage windows), with live burn rate - **Trends & breakdowns**: daily/weekly/monthly charts by agent, model, and token type - **Local & private**: usage logs are parsed and stored locally in SQLite; pricing is refreshed online - **Light & dark themes**, accent colors, and an English/中文 interface ## Supported data sources The following AI coding agents are supported, with some adapter logic ported from ccusage. Windows support also includes Qoder IDE, Qoder CN and WorkBuddy: | Agent | Location | Format | |---|---|---| | Claude Code | `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` / `~/.config/claude/projects` / `~/.claude/projects` | JSONL | | Codex CLI (OpenAI) | `sessions/` and `archived_sessions/` under `$CODEX_HOME` | JSONL | | Gemini CLI | `$GEMINI_DATA_DIR` or `~/.gemini/tmp` | JSON / JSONL | | OpenCode | `$OPENCODE_DATA_DIR` or `~/.local/share/opencode` | SQLite + JSON | | OpenClaw | `$OPENCLAW_DIR` or `~/.openclaw` | JSONL | | GitHub …

Clear status out. **A colorful Rust CLI for scraping public proxy lists and checking their health.** HTTP · HTTPS-labelled · SOCKS4 · SOCKS5 Live per-proxy logs · animated console counters · timestamped exports · reusable history [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-2021-dea584?style=flat-square)](#build-from-source) [![Configuration](https://img.shields.io/badge/config-YAML-5ce1e6?style=flat-square)](config.yaml) [![Sources](https://img.shields.io/badge/raw_sources-18-c0ff72?style=flat-square)](source.txt) [![Interface](https://img.shields.io/badge/interface-CLI-91a7ff?style=flat-square)](#live-output) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Commands](#commands) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Sources](#sources) · [Results](#results-and-history) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
--- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Health checks, not a trust guarantee.** `ALIVE` means the proxy handshake succeeded; it does not verify end-to-end HTTP content, TLS, anonymity, or the operator's trustworthiness. Authentication-required proxies are excluded from checked results. Credentials are never attempted. ## What you get | Collect | Check | Keep | |:---|:---|:---| | **18 editable raw sources** across six GitHub repositories | **Four protocol labels**, with configurable concurrency | Separate **HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS4 / SOCKS5** files | | Source availability reports with readable URLs | One colored log line **as each check finishes** | Timestamped run folders and status summaries | | Deduplicated endpoints and configurable list limits | **ALIVE · SLOW · DEAD · TIMEOUT · AUTH REQUIRED** | Successful endpoints merged into **`history.txt`** | | Optional local input and previous history | Animated title with live counters and a progress heartbeat | Slow-proxy list; dead, timeout, and auth entries excluded | **One executable. One YAML file. Three workflows.** No account or API key required by the app. ```text ┌─ scrape ───────────────► unverified snapshots source.txt ──► public lists ┤ └─ scrape-check ─┐ ├──► live checks ──► results + history proxies.txt + history.txt ──────── check ────┘ ``` `Scrape + Check` also includes configured local input and enabled history. `Scrape` does not perform proxy checks or update history. ## Quick start ### Run the Windows portable build If you have the **`InstaProxy-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip`** bundle: 1. # Cloudflare SaaS 智能优选控制台

基于 Cloudflare Workers / Pages 与 D1 数据库构建的单文件全栈边缘网络控制台，用于将部署在 Cloudflare Pages 或 Workers 上的业务服务通过 **Cloudflare SaaS 自定义主机名** 接入自有域名，并联动国内主流云解析服务商实现**境内优选加速 + 境外自动回源**的双线智能调度。

---

## 核心功能与用途

- **双线智能分流与 SaaS 边缘中继**
  - 自动创建 `saas-origin.<中转域>` 回退源锚点并部署独立分流中继 Worker（`saas-origin-router`）。
  - 支持单个中转域名同时挂载多个独立的 Pages 项目或 Workers 脚本，互不冲突。
  - 自动在云解析端配置双线记录：**境内 / 三网线路**指向优选 IP 或优选 CNAME，**默认 / 境外线路**指向 SaaS 回退源以完成 HTTPS 边缘证书自动签发与回源。
- **多云 DNS 统一管理**
  - 原生集成 **华为云 DNS**、**腾讯云 DNSPod**、**阿里云云解析 DNS** 签名算法，支持多云厂商凭据托管与一键热切换。
- **实时优选节点采集与调度**
  - **六地区优选 IP 池**：实时采集香港（HK）、台湾（TW）、日本（JP）、韩国（KR）、新加坡（SG）、美国（US）节点延迟（自动剥离端口号），默认优先选用香港最优 IP。
  - **近 24 小时优选域名榜**：实时同步三网综合评分最高的 CNAME 优选域名。
- **三网分项遥测与全链路自检**
  - 内置中国电信、中国联通、中国移动三网并发遥测，直观展示各运营商平均延迟。
  - 提供一键全面自检与修复引擎，自动清理残留主机名与冲突 CAA 记录，重构边缘路由映射并轮询 SSL 证书状态。
- **零外部依赖单文件架构**
  - 全部后端 API、密码学签名（HMAC-SHA256 / HMAC-SHA1）及前端响应式拓扑控制台均封装于单个 `_worker.js` 文件中，支持桌面端 12 栏栅格与移动端单栏流式自适应展示。

---

## 部署指南

### 1. 创建 D1 数据库
1. 登录 [Cloudflare 控制台](https://dash.cloudflare.com/)，进入 **存储和数据库 → D1 SQL 数据库**。
2. 点击 **创建数据库**，建议命名为 `CFWUYA`。

### 2. 部署代码（支持 Workers 或 Pages）
- **方式 A：Cloudflare Workers 部署**
  1. 新建 Worker 项目，将 `_worker.js` 完整代码粘贴覆盖默认代码并部署。
  2. 进入 Worker 的 **设置 → 绑定 (Bindings)**，添加 **D1 数据库** 绑定：
     - **变量名称 (Variable name)**：`CFWUYA`（必须严格大写）
     - **D1 数据库**：选择已创建的数据库。
  3. 绑定保存后立即生效，访问 Worker 域名进入安装配置向导。

- **方式 B：Cloudflare Pages 部署**
  1. 将 `_worker.js` 推送至 Git 仓库并关联新建的 Cloudflare Pages 项目（或使用 Direct Upload 上传）。
  2. 进入 Pages 项目的 **设置 → 绑定 (Bindings)**，添加 **D1 数据库** 绑定，变量名称同样严格填写 `CFWUYA`。
  3. **关键步骤**：前往 Pages 的 **部署 (Deployments)** 页面，点击最新一条部署记录右侧的 **Retry deployment（重新部署）**，使 D1 绑定正式生效。

### 3. 初始化配置
首次打开部署域名时，页面将自动引导完成以下配置并加密存储至 D1：
1. **Cloudflare 凭据**：填写 Global API Key（需配合登录邮箱）或具备 `区域:读取`、`DNS:编辑`、`SSL和证书:编辑`、`Worker路由:编辑`、`Worker脚本:编辑`、`Cloudflare Pages:编辑` 权限的 API Token（邮箱留空）。
2. **中转域名准备**：确保所选 Cloudflare 中转域已在 **SSL/TLS → 自定义主机名** 中激活 SaaS 功能。
3. **云解析服务商密钥**：填写华为云、腾讯云或阿里云的 AK/SK 凭据并设置后台管理密码。

---

## 定时自动更新优选 IP

- **Cloudflare Workers 模式**：进入 Worker **设置 → 触发器 → Cron 触发器**，添加以下定时表达式（推荐每 12 小时执行一次）：

      0 */12 * * *

- **Cloudflare Pages 模式**：通过外部监控或定时任务请求以下接口（触发后自动抓取香港最新优选 IP 并批量更新全部已激活 SaaS 节点）：

      GET https://<你的部署域名>/api/auto-update-opt?token=<你的管理密码>

---

## API 凭据获取参考

| 平台 | 控制台地址 | 密钥获取地址 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cloudflare** | https://dash.cloudflare.com/ | https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens |
| **华为云 DNS** | https://console.huaweicloud.com/dns/ | https://console.huaweicloud.com/iam/#/mine/accessKey |
| **腾讯云 DNSPod** | https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cns | https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cam/capi |
| **阿里云 DNS** | https://dns.console.aliyun.com/ | https://ram.console.aliyun.com/manage/ak |

# Game Rebuild Kit

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

**Vision: analyze any game in one click and reconstruct its full implementation.**

- **Analyze:** trace the algorithms, data relationships and execution flow behind game behavior.
- **Reconstruct:** reproduce game systems from recovered evidence, covering logic, animation, physics and rendering.

This release provides an agent skill and a worked example. Universal one-click automation and complete reconstruction remain project goals.

[Open the interactive preview (no sign-in required)](https://remielle-motion-study.pages.dev/)

[![A character shown in five synchronized views: final composite, rig and motion, character color, normal buffer, and bloom.](media/character-debug.webp)](media/character-debug-1080p.mp4)

[Watch the 1080p video](media/character-debug-1080p.mp4)

16 seconds, 1920 x 1080, 30 fps, silent. The views share one animation state and camera. Buffer views use actual outputs from the reconstructed renderer; display transforms are labeled.

## Case: character animation and rendering

The example traces character resources into animation, secondary motion and rendering. The recording shows:

- **Final composite:** character shading and post-processing.
- **Rig / motion:** live rig transforms, animation time and a rotation trace.
- **Character color:** the first character color attachment (MRT0).
- **Normal buffer:** stored RGB values from the normal attachment (MRT3).
- **Bloom:** the composed bloom buffer, displayed at 2x gain.

This is a package-based reconstruction with fitted parameters, not verified native-game equivalence.

## Quick start

1. Ask your agent to read [SKILL.md](skills/game-analysis/SKILL.md).
2. Provide the game build or sample, the question, and the result you need.

> Use game-analysis to investigate this game behavior. State the question, choose the smallest useful evidence path, and explain what is established and what could change the conclusion.

For reuse, copy the entire `skills/game-analysis/` directory into a skill directory supported by your agent. Load the [field guide](skills/game-analysis/references/field-guide.md) when selecting tools, designing checks or reporting results.

The skill and field guide are maintained in English.

## Scope and requirements

| Item | Scope |
|---|---|
| Focus | Game logic, animation, physics, rendering and reconstruction audits |
| Requirements | No runtime dependencies for the skill itself; analysis tools depend on the target and question |
| Included | Analysis instructions, a field guide and representative media |
| Not included | Extracted game assets, format decoders, a viewer runtime or an automated reconstruction system |
| Current evidence | Distilled from one Android / Unity investigation; usefulness across games needs further evaluation |

# railside：地铁列车侧面视觉检测

输入地铁列车过车时线阵相机拍的侧面原始帧，输出整列长图、带编码的零件库，以及和模板车逐件比对后的告警，并提供本地网页浏览和智能体接口。

## 流程

| 步骤 | 命令 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 收录质检 | `railside ingest` | 检查帧序、缺帧、曝光和模糊 |
| 拼接 | `railside stitch` | 帧拼成整列长图，切瓦片 |
| 标定 | `railside calib` | 用已知车体尺寸求 mm/px |
| 模板车 | `railside template` / `label` | 建模板车：定位靶、零件多边形（SAM 2.1 框提示预标 + 人工核） |
| 对齐 | `railside align` | 新趟按定位靶对齐到模板车坐标 |
| 零件匹配 | `railside match`（可选 `segment`） | 逐件找到对应零件，给编码和匹配分 |
| 库与查询 | `railside db` / `query` | 写入 SQLite，按车、转向架、零件类型查 |
| 比对 | `railside compare` | 缺失、位移、转角、遮挡、异物告警 |
| 一键运行 | `railside run <原图目录> --trip <趟号>` | 从原始帧跑到报告 |
| 浏览 | `railside app` | 本地网页：整列浏览、零件详情、两趟对比 |
| 智能体 | `railside agent` / `mcp` | 把查询和比对开放成工具（MCP） |

## 安装

需要 Python 3.12+，用 [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)：

```bash
uv sync
uv run railside --help
uv run pytest 源码/tests
```

分割和 SAM 预标依赖 `ultralytics`（在 `dl` 依赖组里，不随本仓库分发）。

## 目录

```
源码/railside/   代码包，每个步骤一个模块，cli.py 汇总成子命令
源码/tests/      测试（用合成数据，不需要真实图像）
主数据/          零件类型表和比对阈值
数据/            运行时生成（原图、中间结果、成品），不进仓库
```

## 数据

列车图像数据归所属单位所有，不在本仓库中，也不在许可范围内。

## 许可

本项目按 GNU AGPL-3.0 开源，见 `LICENSE`：可以自由使用、修改和分发，但基于本项目做的软件（包括以网络服务形式提供的）也必须按 AGPL-3.0 公开源代码。

如需在闭源产品或商业项目中使用，可另行取得商业授权，请通过 GitHub 联系作者。

# NeonClipping

**Paste a link. Get captioned 9:16 clips in about two minutes. Free, local, open-source.**

NeonClipping turns long YouTube / Twitch / Kick videos (or your own MP4) into vertical, captioned clips with a title and hook for each. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no subscription, no upload.

[![Star on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/iamajmeena/neonclipping?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Star%20on%20GitHub)](https://github.com/iamajmeena/neonclipping) [![Instagram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow-%40iamajmeena-E4405F?style=for-the-badge&logo=instagram&logoColor=white)](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/)

🌐 **Website with one-click Windows setup:** <https://iamajmeena.github.io/neonclipping/>

**Made by [Ajay K Meena](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/)** (Director, DOP, colorist, DaVinci Resolve educator, Jaipur). If NeonClipping saves you time, please ⭐ star the repo and follow [@iamajmeena](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/) on Instagram.

![demo](docs/demo.gif)

![UI](docs/neonclipping-ui.jpg)

📘 **Guides (Hindi + English, PDF):** [docs/NeonClipping-Guide-EN-HI.pdf](docs/NeonClipping-Guide-EN-HI.pdf)  
🤖 **Let an AI agent install it for you:** copy [docs/NEONCLIPPING-AGENT-SETUP-PROMPT.txt](docs/NEONCLIPPING-AGENT-SETUP-PROMPT.txt) into Claude Code, Codex CLI or Cursor.

## How it finds good moments

Two modes, one button.

**⚡ Fast mode (default, videos over 10 min)** copies the trick that makes the fastest clippers fast: never look at the whole video.

1. Download **audio only** (79 MB for an 85-minute video, about 10 s).
2. Take the transcript for free from YouTube's own captions (word-timed). No speech model needed. For other sources a local Whisper model is used as the fallback.
3. Score the whole audio track for *sudden loudness jumps* (vs a 2-minute local baseline), *raised voices* (2–4 kHz energy) and quiet-to-loud transitions.
4. Take the best moments, read each one's transcript with a local LLM (Ollama) and let it score the moment, write a title and a hook. Snap the start and end to sentence boundaries inside your Min/Max length.
5. Download **only the chosen sections** of the video (not the whole file), trim exactly by matching their sound to the audio track, and render 1080x1920 clips with burned-in captions.

**🔬 Deep mode** downloads the whole video, adds optical-flow motion (OpenCV Farneback: fast objects, impacts, camera whips) and cut density to the audio signals, shortlists 4× more candidates and gives the LLM 15 seconds of context before and after each one.

Measured on one machine (RTX 2060, 16 threads), Fast mode, 3 clips each:

| Source | Time |
|---|---|
| 85-minute YouTube stream (YouTube captions) | **97 s** |
| 3-hour Twitch VOD (no captions, local speech model) | **136 s** |
| 90-second YouTube trailer | 21 s |
| 90-second local MP4 | 14 s |

Your numbers depend on network and CPU.

GTA VI PC Recomp is an experimental runtime optimization framework focused on reducing shader compilation stutter, improving asset streaming responsiveness, and enhancing frame pacing consistency in Grand Theft Auto VI for PC.

The project provides dynamic shader cache generation, multi-threaded asset preparation, and render pipeline optimizations designed to improve gameplay smoothness across a wide range of hardware configurations.

## Features

### Rendering Optimizations

- Runtime shader cache generation
- Dynamic PSO (Pipeline State Object) management
- Multi-threaded shader preloading
- Reduced DX12 shader compilation stutter
- Improved render pipeline responsiveness

### CPU Optimization

- Dynamic thread management
- Hybrid-core scheduling support
- Background task balancing
- Reduced main-thread bottlenecks

- Optimized texture streaming
- Improved asset loading prioritization
- Dynamic decompression scheduling
- Reduced world streaming hitching

Compatible with:

- NVIDIA DLSS

- Intel XeSS

mankidev/antialgorithm.content:
# antialgorithm

![Six posters without the skill on top, six with it below](images/showcase.png)

Claude Code skill for creative work: names, copy, story, game ideas, posters, UI. It makes the model name its first, most average pick, then move away from it for a reason taken from the project.

Both rows came from the same prompt: `Design a poster for a music festival as a 400x600 SVG. Save the final SVG as final.svg in the current folder.` The top row is one batch of six runs without the skill, none left out. The bottom row is picked from about a dozen runs made while the skill was still being written.

![Chart of how often a choice gets picked: a tall peak around the average marked as the safe zone, flat on both sides](images/graph.png)

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/mankidev/antialgorithm ~/.claude/skills/antialgorithm
```

The scripts need Python 3. `check.py` also needs numpy, Pillow and `rsvg-convert` (or the cairosvg package).

## Scripts

`seed.py` rolls a starting point when the request is thin. A visual seed gives a making method, colors, layout, type, a verb and a scale for the idea, a setting, a region and, half the time, an object. A text seed gives a voice, a way in and a register. An idea seed gives a verb, a constraint, a scale and a pressure. It draws from system randomness, so two people sending the same prompt start in different places. It also saves each seed to `history.jsonl` in the skill folder and skips values from the last few, so your own seeds don't repeat from one session to the next. `--keep "axis=value"` holds an axis fixed, which lets you keep a subject and roll only the look.

`moves.py` keeps a short log of the main move behind each off-default answer, such as "neon tube wall, almost no type". The model reads it before showing new work, so it doesn't reuse a move that worked last time just because it worked.

`rough.py` takes an SVG and shakes its straight lines, shapes and letters, and breaks the even spacing of repeated marks, so a hand-made look drawn in code stops looking plotted. It is only for hand-made methods such as print, paint, stamps and ink; screen, camera and render looks keep their own marks.

`check.py` renders an SVG at full size and at icon size and lists text that runs off an edge, sits under a shape, has low contrast or is too small. The size limit fits posters; for an app screen use `--min-text 0.6`.

Visual rules live in `visuals.md`, which the model reads only for visual work, so a name or a slogan doesn't load them.

MIT

# homeport

**一句话：让 Claude、Google、Stripe 这些网站，在你所有设备上都看到同一个“住宅 IP”。**

很多人用机场节点访问 Claude / Google，节点一会儿日本一会儿美国，IP 来回跳，再加上机场 IP 是机房 IP，很容易触发风控：注册要验证、付款失败、身份认证不过、甚至封号。

homeport 做的事情很简单：把这些“敏感网站”单独挑出来，统一走一条固定的**住宅代理**；其他网站照旧走你的机场，速度不受影响。

> 🛒 **还没有住宅 IP？** 看这篇 👉 [便宜静态住宅 IP 购买教程](https://x.com/0xjackkk/status/2117862295397335283)

---

## ⚡ 懒人一键版（推荐小白）

打开 👉 **https://0xkaka.github.io/homeport/**

1. 照着服务商后台，填上住宅代理的地址、端口、用户名、密码；
2. 选你的设备和软件，点「复制」，到软件里粘贴（iPhone 可以直接扫码加节点）；
3. 打开 `ipv4.webshare.io` 看 IP 对不对。

账号密码只在你自己浏览器里处理，不会上传。下面是详细的手动教程，一键版搞不定再看。

---

## 目录

1. [原理（看不懂可以跳过）](#1-原理看不懂可以跳过)
2. [开始前要准备什么](#2-开始前要准备什么)
3. [Clash Party（Mac / Windows）](#3-clash-partymac--windows)
4. [Clash Verge Rev（Windows / Mac）](#4-clash-verge-revwindows--mac)
5. [安卓：FlClash](#5-安卓flclash)
6. [小火箭 Shadowrocket（iPhone / iPad / Mac）](#6-小火箭-shadowrocketiphone--ipad--mac)
7. [检查是否成功](#7-检查是否成功)
8. [Claude Code、终端、Chrome 的额外设置](#8-claude-code终端chrome-的额外设置)
9. [常见问题](#9-常见问题)
10. [哪些网站会走住宅出口](#10-哪些网站会走住宅出口)
11. [给维护者：修改规则](#11-给维护者修改规则)

---

## 1. 原理（看不懂可以跳过）

```
            ┌──────────────── 敏感网站（Claude / Google / Stripe …）────────────────┐
你的设备 ──►│  跳板（你在机场里选的那个节点）──► 🏠住宅出口-勿选（住宅代理）──► 网站 │
            └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
            其他网站 ──► 照常走你的机场
```

- **🏠住宅出口-勿选**：你买的住宅代理。网站最终看到的就是它的 IP。所有设备填同一个，IP 就一致了。
- **跳板**：国内直连住宅代理，握手内容是明文，容易被干扰断线；先经过一个机场节点再连过去就稳了。跳板就是**你平时在机场里选的那个节点**，你切到哪个，住宅代理就经过哪个；跳板换来换去**不影响**最终 IP。
- 另外，Claude 的 IPv6 地址走住宅代理会报错（502），这套规则直接把它拦掉，让设备自动改用 IPv4，你不用管。

---

## 2. 开始前要准备什么

### ① 一个机场订阅（你现在翻墙用的那个）

已经能正常翻墙就行。**任何机场、任何地区的节点都行**，节点叫什么名字都没关系：住宅代理会经过你在机场里选的那个节点。

### ② 一条静态住宅代理（HTTP 或 SOCKS5）

去住宅代理服务商购买，选的时候注意三点：
（不会买的话先看 👉 [便宜静态住宅 IP 购买教程](https://x.com/0xjackkk/status/2117862295397335283)）

| 要求 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **静态（Static）** | IP 固定不变。别买“动态/轮换（Rotating）”的。 |
| **住宅（Residential / ISP）** | 不要买“机房（Datacenter）”的。 |
| **HTTP 或 SOCKS5，带用户名密码** | 两种都支持。后台写的是哪个就用哪个，不确定先试 HTTP，不通换 SOCKS5。 |

买好后，后台能看到这样四项信息，**抄下来**，后面每台设备都要填同样的：

| 项目 | 举例（假的，别照抄） |
| --- | --- |
| 地址 / Host（Proxy Address，不是 Assigned IP） | `p.webshare.io` |
| 端口 / Port | `80` |
| 用户名 / Username | `abcd1234-1` |
| 密码 / Password | `xyz789` |

> ⚠️ **地址怎么填：**
> - 后台只给了一个 `IP:端口`（比如 `50.2.71.50:443`）：地址就填这个 IP。
> - 后台同时有代理地址和 Assigned IP（比如 Webshare）：**填代理地址，不是 Assigned IP / 出口 IP。** 比如 Webshare 后台一行里同时有 `p.webshare.io`（代理地址）和 `9.x.x.x`（Assigned IP），要填的是 `p.webshare.io`；那个 IP 是最后网站看到的出口，用来核对结果。

> ⭐ **Webshare 用户**：后台代理列表上方的 **Connection Method** 选 **Backbone Connection**，最稳定。别选 **Rotating Proxy Endpoint**，那个 IP 如果有问题，官方会自动换，换了你要去后台手动获取重新配置才行。切好后列表里的 Proxy Address 就是 `p.webshare.io`，用户名带 `-1` 这类后缀，照着填就行。

> 💡 有的服务商给的是一整串，比如 `p.webshare.io:80:abcd1234-1:xyz789`，按冒号拆开就是 地址:端口:用户名:密码。还有一种是 `用户名:密码@地址:端口`。拆开后分别填到一键配置页的四个格子里。

> 💡 **用 SOCKS5 的**：Mac / Windows / 安卓配置里把 `type: http`（或 `type: "http"`）改成 `socks5`；小火箭节点类型选 **Socks5**。一键页上直接选 SOCKS5 就行。

handcrafted **pop-up papercraft style**, for any subject: printed cardstock pieces with thin cut edges that fold up on
hinges from a printed ground, warm soft layered shadows, a tilt-shift macro lens looking down into the world, calm

# skill-distill

A frontier model did a task well. Can an open-weight model do the same task, given the right instructions?

`skill-distill` is a skill for Claude Code or Codex (the **teacher**). You call it at the end of a good
session and name a **student**: an agent harness plus a model, for example omp with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
The teacher then loops:

1. reads the session and writes a skill for the student;
2. starts the student in tmux, on a fresh copy of the starting state, with the original prompt and the skill;
3. compares what the student produced with what the reference produced;
4. finds the first place the student went wrong and fixes the skill there;
5. runs again, three trials per version, until the student matches the reference.

You make the final call: the teacher shows you the reference and the student's best results side by side,
and the skill counts as done only when you accept it.

The result is two things: the reusable **operator skill** in this repo, and a **produced skill** for one task,
one model and one harness.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/sybil-solutions/skill-distill
ln -s "$PWD/skill-distill/skills/skill-distill" ~/.claude/skills/skill-distill    # Claude Code
ln -s "$PWD/skill-distill/skills/skill-distill" ~/.agents/skills/skill-distill    # Codex
```

Requirements: `tmux`, `git`, Python 3.10+, and the student harness installed and pointed at its model.
For web results, `pip install playwright pillow && playwright install chromium`.

## Use

At the end of a session that went well:

> distill this session into a skill for omp with deepseek-v4.1-flash on my local server

The teacher follows [`skills/skill-distill/SKILL.md`](skills/skill-distill/SKILL.md). You can watch the
students work with `tmux attach -t distill-<task>`.

## What's in it

| path | what |
|---|---|
| `skills/skill-distill/SKILL.md` | the loop the teacher follows |
| `skills/skill-distill/scripts/distill.py` | run bookkeeping: `init`, `trial`, `status`, `wait`, `evidence`, `verdict`, `ledger`, `report`, `accept` |
| `skills/skill-distill/scripts/extract_session.py` | Claude Code / Codex / omp session log → readable reference (drops system and AGENTS.md text) |
| `skills/skill-distill/scripts/capture_web.py` | serve a web app, drive it in headless Chromium, save screenshots and errors |
| `skills/skill-distill/adapters/` | one script per student harness: omp, pi, Codex, Claude Code, opencode |
| `skills/skill-distill/templates/student-skill/` | the starting shape of a produced skill |
| `examples/` | finished runs: the prompt, the produced skill, the ledger, screenshots |

## Rules the teacher follows

- The student gets the reference's prompt verbatim, a clean starting state, and the skill. Nothing else:
  the student harness's own global context files and skills are turned off where the harness allows it.
- The skill may not contain the reference's finished output or a script that writes it. It teaches the
  steps, decisions, traps…

# Antigravity Flow (`antigravity-flow`)

An Antigravity plugin that packages **Google Flow** ([flow.google.com](https://flow.google.com)) as a modular AI filmmaking and creative-tools workflow powered by Antigravity's built-in `browser` subagent — with zero external MCP servers or local Playwright daemons required.

## Installation

### From GitHub (Recommended)

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/WeZZard/antigravity-flow
```

### Local Development (Symlink)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WeZZard/antigravity-flow.git
ln -s "$(pwd)/antigravity-flow" ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-flow
```

Validate the plugin manifest and structure locally:

```bash
agy plugin validate . --strict
```

Then manage or toggle the plugin on Antigravity's Customizations page.

## Included Customizations

### Rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`)
Always-on operating contract when the plugin is enabled:
- Opens `https://flow.google.com/` directly (avoiding legacy redirect hops) and delegates all Flow UI operations to Antigravity's built-in `browser` subagent (`Model: "flash"`), reusing the same tab/session via `send_message`.
- Runs a **Fast-Path Authentication Check** using above-the-fold visual, DOM (`Account details`, `+ New project`, `/project/<id>`), and network (`batchexecute` HTTP `200`) signals to skip unnecessary sign-in prompts when already signed in.
- Supports **Checkpoint Mode** (default: reads live `Generating will use <N> credits` and confirms before clicking `Start generation` or paid `4K Upscaled · 50 credits` exports) and **Full-Auto Mode** (automatically triggered from prompt cues like `"auto mode"`, `"full-auto"`, `"run unattended"`, or equivalent phrasing in any language).
- Enforces hard safety pauses for Google sign-in, CAPTCHA, and quota/payment walls.
- Standardizes local file staging for uploads (`browser_sandbox/uploads/`) and visual references (`browser_sandbox/references/`).

### Skills (`skills/`)

It uses NTFS-3G and macFUSE so you can copy files in Finder without reformatting the drive. It also supports per-disk auto mount, safe ejection, and copying with SHA-256 verification. [Official website](https://ixiehao.github.io/ezNTFS/) · [Download 0.5.1 for Mac](https://github.com/ixiehao/ezNTFS/releases/download/v0.5.1/ezNTFS-0.5.1-arm64.pkg) · [Release notes and checksums](https://github.com/ixiehao/ezNTFS/releases/tag/v0.5.1) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/ixiehao/ezNTFS/issues) ## Requirements - Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later. - The ezNTFS installer automatically checks for macFUSE 5.5.0. If it’s already installed, continue with ezNTFS. If it’s missing, install it once per Mac from the [official macFUSE 5.5.0 release](https://github.com/macfuse/macfuse/releases/tag/macfuse-5.5.0). - Administrator approval to install the app, system mount service, and NTFS-3G driver from the ezNTFS PKG. - The app and bundled executables use ad-hoc signing. The PKG is unsigned and not notarized. The release page includes SHA-256 checksums. ## Use 1. Connect an external NTFS disk and choose **Mount Read-Write** on its card or in the menu bar. If another driver is managing it, unmount the volume normally first. 2. For automatic mounting, turn on **Mount on Connection** in Settings and **Auto Mount** for the disk. Drives without a stable identifier can be mounted manually. 3. **Copy & Verify** copies regular files and folders one at a time, then reads back each copy and checks its SHA-256 digest. The batch is delivered in a new folder after verification. It includes empty files and directories. File dates and extended attributes use the driver’s metadata support. Full macOS permissions, hard-link relationships, and special files are outside this copy mode. 4. When finished, close files on the disk and choose **Safely Eject**. This ejects the entire physical disk and all its volumes. If macOS reports it is in use, close the windows or apps using it and retry. 5. Closing the main window keeps ezNTFS running in the menu bar. Choose **Open ezNTFS** to bring the window back, or **Quit ezNTFS** to exit. ## Settings and troubleshooting - The **Language** menu and Settings share the same choices: Follow System, English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese. # 🚆 RailVani — Indian Railways & Metro Announcement Simulator

> **Simulate authentic station public address announcements across 190+ Indian Railways trains and all 16 operational Metro networks in India with official human announcer voice audio.**

---

## 🌟 Key Features

- **🚉 Indian Railways Station Annunciator (`/railway`):**
  - Retro LED dot-matrix / split-flap Passenger Information Display System (PIDS).
  - Authentic South Central Railway human voice clips in **Telugu, Hindi & English** with genuine station platform chimes.
  - Four announcement situations: *Is on platform*, *Has arrived*, *Arriving shortly*, and *Running late*.
  - Realistic platform berth selector (`PF 01` – `PF 10`) and intermediate via station broadcasting.
  - Master broadcast audio player with instant MP3 downloads.

- **🚇 Metros of India Annunciator (`/metro`):**
  - In-coach digital LCD PIDS annunciator with route corridor lines (Blue, Red, Green).
  - Tri-lingual announcements with door opening warnings (*"Doors will open on the left"*).
  - Interactive directory covering all **16 Indian Metro systems**: Delhi (DMRC), Bengaluru (Namma Metro), Mumbai Metro, Kolkata Metro (Underwater line), Chennai, Hyderabad (HMRL), Ahmedabad, Pune, Kochi, Lucknow, Jaipur, Nagpur, Kanpur, Agra, Noida, and Navi Mumbai.

- **🎧 Immersive Station Ambience:**
  - Ambient railway platform background soundscape (low-frequency diesel locomotive idling rumble, distant concourse murmur, track clicks, and twin-tone pneumatic train horns).
  - Interactive visitor dock to play, pause, mute, or adjust ambient sound volume.

- **🛠️ Fleet Database Manager (`/railway/add-train`):**
  - Full CRUD administrative console for Indian Railways fleet trains.
  - Add new trains, edit existing routes, change destinations, and assign master human voice audio engines.
  - Client-side persistence via `localStorage` with real-time UI synchronization.

- **🔒 Administrative Security:**
  - Database editing, template modifications, and audio dashboards are secured under the Admin Console (`/login`).
  - Unauthenticated visitors can freely browse, search, and generate announcements.

---

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- npm or yarn

### Installation
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/ATLURI0001/RailVani.git
cd RailVani

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start local development server

```
Open [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173) in your browser.

```bash
npm run build
```
The output directory will be `dist/`.

---

Access to the Fleet Database Editor (`/railway/add-train`) and Announcement Templates Editor (`/railway/templates`) is restricted to authorized operators via the Admin Console (`/login`).
Station administrator credentials can be configured securely using environment variables:
- `VITE_ADMIN_EMAIL`
- `VITE_ADMIN_PASSWORD`

# Google One 工具包（MuMu 模拟器 + Frida）

**`g1.30tb`已在大部分区域下架，可以先搞搞3个月打折的Ultra 5X**

通过 Frida 注入模拟器里的 Google One 进程，调用 Play BillingClient：
**扫描账号可用的全部订阅 offer（免费/付费）**，以及**拉起任意 SKU 的 Play 收银台**（只弹出，不自动订阅）。

---

## 文件清单

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `ultra0_core.py` | 自包含核心（adb/frida-server/计费模块/注入模板，从原 ultra0.py 抽取） |
| `extract_core.py` | 生成器：从原版 ultra0.py 重新抽取 ultra0_core.py（仅维护时用） |
| `one_common.py` | 公共环境准备（选设备/root/frida-server/计费模块/Play 商店保活），所有脚本共用 |
| `launch_checkout.py` + `launch_checkout.js` | **拉起任意 SKU 收银台**（主力脚本） |
| `scan_all.py` | 全量扫描 70 个候选 SKU 的所有 offer（免费+付费+token），零风险 |
| `query_sku.py` | 只查指定几个 SKU，零风险 |
| `probe_env.py` | 环境诊断（frida 版本 / Java 桥 / Play 商店状态），出问题先跑它 |
| `scan_everything.py` + `scan_offers.js` | 穷举账号全部 SKU，输出带定价阶段的原始 JSON 并渲染清单 |
| `render_multi.py` | 合并多地区 JSON，生成 `SKU-清单.md` |
| `scan_result_*.json` | 各地区扫描原始数据（已脱敏：serial 已掩码、token 已置空） |
| `SKU-清单.md` | 多地区金额对照 + 人民币比价清单 |

> 整个文件夹**自包含、无外部依赖**：把 `google-one-tools` 拷到任何机器（装有
> Python3.9+ 和 frida 16.x）都能直接跑，不需要原版仓库里的脚本。

## 环境要求（缺一不可）

1. **本机 frida 必须 16.x**（推荐 16.7.19）：
   ```powershell
   py -m pip install frida==16.7.19
   ```
   > ⚠️ frida 17.x 在 MuMu（Android 12 / x86_64）上 Java 桥损坏（`Java is not defined`），
   > 所有功能静默失效。设备上的 frida-server 也必须同版本（脚本会自动下载匹配版）。
2. **自包含核心**：所有对原版 `ultra0.py` 的依赖已抽取进 `ultra0_core.py`，
   本文件夹可整体拷贝到别处使用；要更新抽取范围，改 `extract_core.py` 后重跑 `py extract_core.py`。
3. 模拟器已 root、已登录 Google 账号、装有 Google One 和 Play 商店。
4. 用 `py` 而不是 `python`（本机的 `python` 是商店占位符，跑不了）。

## 快速上手

```powershell
cd C:\path\to\google-one-tools

# 0. 环境自检（第一次先跑这个）
py probe_env.py

# 1. 扫描当前账号的全部 offer（免费+付费，不下单）
py scan_all.py                       # 自动选第一台模拟器
py scan_all.py 127.0.0.1:16384       # 多开时指定实例

# 2. 只查某几个 SKU
py query_sku.py g1.30tb g1.20tb

# 3. 拉起收银台（弹出后人工确认，脚本不点订阅）
py launch_checkout.py --sku g1.20tb                    # 自动选设备
py launch_checkout.py --sku g1.30tb 127.0.0.1:16384    # 指定实例
```

## SKU 对照表

| 档位 | SKU | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 30 GB / 100GB / 200GB | `g1.30gb` / `g1.100gb` / `g1.200gb` | 基础存储 |
| 2TB / 5TB / 10TB / 20TB / 30TB | `g1.2tb` / `g1.5tb` / `g1.10tb` / `g1.20tb` / `g1.30tb` | 基础存储 |
| 年付版 | 上面任一 + `.annual`（如 `g1.2tb.annual`） | 部分档无年付 |
| AI Plus (400GB) | `g1.play.helium` | 常有 12/6/3/1 月免费试用 |
| AI Pro (5TB) | `g1.2tb.ai.subs_variant` | 常有 12+6+6+6 月免费试用 |
| Ultra 20TB | `g1.play.20tb` | 试用看账号资格 |
| Ultra AI Pro (30TB) | `g1.play.ai.pro` / `g1.30tb` | 多数号无试用 |
| 2TB 首三月折扣 | `g1.2tb.3months_ip_85p.acq` | introprice，非免费 |

> 免费试用档基本只挂在**带 `play` 前缀**或 **`subs_variant`** 的 SKU 上；
> 带 `.eft` 后缀的是试用专用 SKU。以 `scan_all.py` 的实际返回为准。

## 多模拟器实例

- `pick_device` 默认选 adb 列表第一台。**多开时必须指定**：位置参数或环境变量 `SERIAL`：
  ```powershell
  py launch_checkout.py --sku g1.20tb 127.0.0.1:16384
  $env:SERIAL="127.0.0.1:16384"; py scan_all.py
  ```
  （`16384` 只是 MuMu 12 的默认 ADB 端口；多开实例的实际端口以 `adb devices` 为准。）
- frida 连接按 serial 精确匹配，不会串台。

## VPN 共存（本工具包刻意支持）

- **不调用** `ultra0.ensure_network()`：不清设备代理、不杀 Clash/v2rayNG。
- 注入走 adb 通道（127.0.0.1:xxxxx），与模拟器内 VPN 互…

# DataCat

Self-hosted observability: metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, infrastructure
and alerts in one place. DataCat runs on your infrastructure, stores data in PostgreSQL (or telemetry in
ClickHouse, if you choose; see docs/SELF_HOSTING.md), and accepts OpenTelemetry and Datadog-compatible agent traffic.
No hosted account or external service is required.

## Features

- Metrics explorer, formulas, dashboards and host maps
- Searchable logs with facets, live tail and trace correlation
- APM service catalog, trace explorer and waterfall
- Metric, log and trace monitors with webhook/Slack notifications
- Organizations, local accounts, single-use invites, API/application keys
- OpenTelemetry Collector-based host agent and Node.js/Python instrumentation libraries
- One production process serving the API, web UI, installer and downloads

![DataCat dashboard](docs/images/dashboard.jpg)

## Quick start with Docker Compose

Requirements: Docker Engine with the Compose plugin, Git, and OpenSSL.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/replit/datacat
cd datacat
cp .env.example .env
sed -i "s/^POSTGRES_PASSWORD=.*/POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 24)/" .env
sed -i "s/^SESSION_SECRET=.*/SESSION_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32)/" .env
chmod 600 .env
mkdir -p downloads
docker compose up -d --build
```

Open **http://localhost:3000**, create your admin account and organization, then create
an API key under **Organization Settings**. Setup asks for a setup token, printed in the
server log (`docker compose logs datacat | grep "setup token"`) unless you set `DATACAT_SETUP_TOKEN`.
Set `PUBLIC_URL` to your externally reachable HTTPS origin before inviting colleagues or
installing agents remotely.

Agent binaries and SDK packages are separate release assets. Put them (including
`SHA256SUMS`) in `downloads/` to serve them from your instance.

## Sending data

DataCat accepts the Datadog public intake API and OTLP/HTTP:

| Sender | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Datadog Agent 7.56.2 (metrics, logs, check runs, traces) | Tested in CI-style runs |
| Datadog Agent 7.85.4 (metrics, logs, check runs, traces) | Tested with captured payloads; including the newer string-table trace format |
| Datadog Agent 7.57–7.84 | Not tested individually. Agents that send traces in a format DataCat cannot read get a 422, never a silent 202 |
| OpenTelemetry Collector / SDKs (OTLP/HTTP) | `/v1/traces`, `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/logs` (also under `/otlp/v1/*`) |
| DataCat Agent and libraries | Tested in CI |

`GET /api/v1/intake/stats` shows, per intake path, how many items were stored and how many were dropped since the
server started.

Sign-in uses local email/password accounts; members join through single-use invite links.

## From source

Use Node.js **22.15+**, pnpm **10.11.0** and PostgreSQL **14+**. Node 22 also meets
the Node SDK requirement; older Node 20 releases are not supported by the current SDK.

Leonida

Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series) running natively on Windows, built on your PC from your own copy.

Status | How to build | How it works | Want to help? | Credits | License | Discord

Leonida is a static recompilation project. The Xbox Series CPU is x86-64 like a PC, so the game's code is loaded and run natively, and the console's system software is reimplemented. The console's precompiled RDNA2 GPU programs are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan. The game's models, textures and audio are read from your package. All of this happens **on your PC, from your own copy of the game**. > [!IMPORTANT] > This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You > need your own copy, with its files already readable on disk. Nothing here decrypts or works around any protection. > Everything the build creates (the generated shaders, extracted assets, the runtime folder and your saves) comes > from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files. Discord: https://discord.gg/rexed

The game does not boot yet.** Everything that can be done without the game's executable is in place, so work on booting can start as soon as one is available to a developer. | What | Status | |---|---| | Finding and checking your copy (Xbox Series 1.0.2.1) | ✅ Works | | Shaders: carve, unpack native RDNA2 code, disassemble | ✅ All 26,503 | | Shaders: RDNA2 → SPIR-V translation | ✅ **All 26,503 translated**: 2,236 VS, 12,101 PS, 2,689 CS, 9,282 mesh, 195 geometry, with a per-shader metadata index for pipeline creation. # Xbox2Windows

Xbox2Windows researches static recompilation from Xbox Series X|S (Scarlett) to x64 Windows. It translates selected x64 machine code into C++ and selected gfx1013 shaders into desktop DXIL. The public tests build their own inputs and run without a game installation.

**Startup status.** Source-built Windows programs run from entry to process exit. The main executable was absent from the inspected package. Execution of the title's CPU code, full-game startup and frame rate remain unverified.

[Build on Windows](#first-build) · [Run the standalone GPU check](#run-the-gpu-check) · [Choose an experiment](#choose-an-experiment) · [Contribute or review a PR](CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Current results and open work

| What runs | What was compared |
|---|---|
| **x64 programs from PE entry** | A two-record archive reader runs with blast 1.3 decompression under Windows, the PE mapper and the recompiled build. The three agree on output bytes, callback order, completed records, allocations, releases and exit status, including truncation and a refused output window. [Reproduce the archive comparison](docs/experiments.md#recompiling-the-blast-decoder) |
| **Pixel shaders** | In one package scan, 334 pixel records compiled to DXIL and produced matching pixels on an RTX 4060 Laptop and WARP under the tested bindings. A separate depth test exchanged two buffers and changed 897 of 1,024 depth samples on both adapters. [Color readback](docs/experiments.md#offline-pixel-shader-recompilation) · [Depth and bindings](docs/experiments.md#buffered-depth-export) |
| **Compute shaders** | Of 2,689 package records, 12 ran under the tested UAV bindings. Each adapter passed 14 full-buffer comparisons, including dispatches with different group counts. [Dispatch and readback](docs/experiments.md#compute-uav-stores-from-a-native-container) |
| **Mesh shaders** | A specialized entry fetched indexed vertices from a GPU buffer. Two position sets covered 1,024 and 276 pixels on a 32×32 target, matching the CPU reference on hardware and WARP. [Mesh draw and specialization limits](docs/experiments.md#single-group-mesh-entry-specialization) |
| **Windows runtime** | Bink frame-buffer allocations reach the Windows heap through the shared provider. The FidelityFX experiment follows scratch writes from two passes through the RCAS output on an 8×4 tile. [Allocation, failure and retry](docs/experiments.md#frame-buffers-through-the-shared-windows-heap) · [Upscaler pixel comparison](docs/experiments.md#last-writers-of-the-pass-26-scratch-reads) |

omonkeyz/xbox-emulator.content: # Xbox Emulator **Running the Xbox Series X|S library on PC. A continuation of [drycheetah84/TomBox](https://github.com/drycheetah84/TomBox).** The runtime reimplements the console's platform layer (Xbox-flavoured Direct3D 12, precompiled RDNA2 shaders, unified-memory textures, system libraries) so dumped, already-decrypted Xbox Series X|S builds run as normal Windows processes. It is not tied to any single title. This repo tracks our continuation — new titles brought up, platform calls extended, shader stages unlocked. Uses legally obtained, already-decrypted dumps. It contains no game files, binaries or build output. **Contributing:** pull requests are welcome, especially console library functions still marked missing in the [library map](docs/LIBRARY_MAP.md). # Riemann Hypothesis in Lean — by Levent Alpöge (with Claude)

> **The proof in this repository is the work of [Levent Alpöge](https://alpo.ge/).**
> On 2026-11-20 he announced that, working with Claude, he had found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that extends to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (for Dirichlet L-functions), and that the argument is fully formalized in Lean without assumptions.
> All credit belongs to Levent Alpöge (and Claude). This repository is an unmodified mirror of the Lean code he published, put on GitHub so that people and agents can browse, clone and check it.
>
> 本仓库只是镜像：证明由数学家 Levent Alpöge（和 Claude 合作）完成，署名与一切功劳归他。代码原样搬运，没有改动。

- Announcement (4 pages): https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf
- Original download: https://alpo.ge/lean.tar.gz.part01 … https://alpo.ge/lean.tar.gz.part14
- Merged archive in this repo's [Releases](https://github.com/CocoSgt/riemann-hypothesis-lean/releases/tag/v2026-11-20)

**Status.** As of mirroring (2026-11-20), no independent build or review of this code has been published. Treat it as a claimed proof until it has been compiled and checked.

---

## What is proved

The target statements are short. Read these two files first.

`src/Main.lean`

```lean
import Statements
import Supplements.Kernels.MainTheoremsAll

theorem riemannHypothesis : RiemannHypothesis := rhOfAll

theorem riemannZeta_eq_zero_re : RiemannZetaZerosOnLine := rhOfAll

theorem LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re : DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf := allChi

theorem LFunction_eq_zero_re : DirichletLZerosOnLine := claimAll.2.1

theorem LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive : PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine := critAll
```

- `RiemannHypothesis` is **Mathlib's own definition** (`Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean`, line 185 at the pinned commit), so the headline statement comes from Mathlib, outside this repository:

  ```lean
  def RiemannHypothesis : Prop :=
    ∀ (s : ℂ) (_ : riemannZeta s = 0) (_ : ¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1)) (_ : s ≠ 1), s.re = 1 / 2
  ```
- `src/Statements.lean` (16 lines, imports only Mathlib) defines the other four statements:
  - `RiemannZetaZerosOnLine`: every zero of `riemannZeta` other than the trivial zeros `-2(n+1)` and `s = 1` has real part `1/2`
  - `DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf`: for every Dirichlet character `χ` mod `N`, `LFunction χ s ≠ 0` when `Re s > 1/2` (excluding `χ = 1, s = 1`)
  - `DirichletLZerosOnLine` / `PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine`: zeros of Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip lie on `Re s = 1/2` (GRH for Dirichlet L-functions)
- The proof terms come from `src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean`:
  `allChi := UpperTheory.FinalTheorems.everyCharacter`, `rhOfAll := Formalism.VW.rh_of_every allChi`, `critAll`, `claimAll`.

# riemann-hypothesis

[![checks](https://github.com/leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis/actions/workflows/checks.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/leanprover-community/riemann-hypothesis/actions/workflows/checks.yml)

A [Comparator](https://github.com/leanprover/comparator) setup and community build cache for the Lean formalization that
claims a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, and of GRH for Dirichlet L-functions, announced on
2026-11-20 at <https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf>.

The first commit, `40e56bab`, is the submitted Lean source exactly as published. Since then,
cleanup pull requests have removed 10,724 of its 175,187 files and edited 18; the
[notes](verification/NOTES.md#source) list them. Check out `40e56bab` for the original. This
repository also adds Comparator files and cache infrastructure:

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`src/Challenge.lean`](src/Challenge.lean) | the five theorems, stated in a file that imports only Mathlib |
| [`comparator.json`](comparator.json) | the Comparator config |
| [`export-targets.txt`](export-targets.txt) | the declarations to export |
| [`verification/`](verification/NOTES.md) | our notes, and the results once there are some |
| [`scripts/`](scripts/) | public Lake cache configuration and reproducible bootstrap/publishing tools |

## Using the build cache

Fetch and restore Mathlib and this project's compiled modules:

```bash
lake exe cache get
lake build --no-build
```

The cache settings are in `lakefile.toml`; no user configuration is needed. The first command
fetches both caches anonymously and extracts the oleans to `.lake/build`. It prefers a successful
CI build matching the current clean source, configuration, dependency manifest and toolchain;
documentation-only commits can reuse the same cache. Otherwise it tries the original published
cache. The second command checks the default build targets without compiling them. The original
project cache is 4.94 GB and contains portable Lean outputs and generated C. Subsequent ordinary
builds compile changed modules and their dependents.

The community cache includes outputs from **untrusted pull requests and volunteer machines**.
Download integrity checks do not verify proofs. Use an independent fresh build when you need
to trust the result.

The [cache notes](verification/CACHE.md) describe the pinned published archive, the cheaper
bootstrap that reuses its proofs, and how to produce and publish future caches. For independent
verification, follow the clean-build instructions below.

EL4CTEO/fast-anything.content:
Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow.

Rewriting a whole app in Rust costs months, minute-long compiles and gigabytes of `target/`. Most of the runtime sits in a few functions anyway. **fast-anything** finds those functions, has your coding agent port *only them* to Rust, proves the port gives the same results on real recorded calls, and swaps it in. One command, fully reversible.

## Install ```sh npm i -g @el4cteo/fast-anything # or: cargo install fast-anything ``` Ports are compiled with your Rust toolchain ([rustup](https://rustup.rs)). ## Use ```sh fast-anything go --agent claude -- python app.py # or: -- node app.ts / ruby app.rb / java App.java / mvn exec:java / gradle run / go run . / php app.php / clang -O2 main.c ``` Or step by step: | command | what it does | |---|---| | `scan -- ` | profiles the app, ranks functions by time × how portable they are | | `port [id]` | records up to 500 real calls, creates a one-function Rust crate + `TASK.md` | | `verify` | release-builds the port and replays every recorded call | | `enable` / `disable` | swaps the Rust in or out (one marked block, removed byte for byte) | | `bench` | times the whole app, original vs Rust, interleaved runs | | `report` | markdown + SVG card for your PR | | `doctor` | checks Rust, your runtimes and your agents | `--agent` takes `claude`, `codex`, or any command that reads a prompt on stdin. Without it, hand `TASK.md` to whatever you use. ## Proof, not vibes

# Google AI Trial Tool

内容为转载，来自q群797481450
这次的会封号 ，涉及工具调用，慎用


通过 Frida 注入 Google One 进程调用 BillingClient API，发现并激活隐藏的 $0 免费试用。

## 前提条件

| 组件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **MuMu 模拟器** | 已启动，已登录 Google 账号，已绑定付款方式 |
| **adb** | 在 PATH 中，或设置 `ADB_PATH` 环境变量 |
| **frida** (host) | `pip install frida-tools`，版本 ≥ 16 |
| **frida-server** (device) | 推送到设备 `/data/local/tmp/frida-server` 并赋予执行权限 |
| **module.apk** (device) | 包含 BillingClient 库的 APK，推送到 `/data/local/tmp/module.apk` |
| **Google One** | 设备上已安装 (`com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.red`) |

## 设备准备

```bash
# 连接 MuMu
adb connect 127.0.0.1:16384

# 推送 frida-server（从 https://github.com/frida/frida/releases 下载对应架构）
adb push frida-server /data/local/tmp/frida-server
adb shell "chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/frida-server"

# 推送 module.apk（包含 com.android.billingclient 的 APK）
adb push module.apk /data/local/tmp/module.apk
```

## 用法

```bash
# 列出当前账号所有可用试用
./auto-trial.sh --list

# 激活 Pro (5TB, $19.99/mo) 3个月免费试用
./auto-trial.sh --product pro --dur 3mo

# 激活 Pro variant (5TB, $19.99/mo) 12个月免费试用 ★推荐
./auto-trial.sh --product pro12 --dur 12mo

# 激活 Ultra 20x (30TB, $199.99/mo) 12个月免费试用
./auto-trial.sh --product 20x --dur 12mo

# 激活 Ultra 5x (20TB, $99.99/mo) 6个月免费试用
./auto-trial.sh --product 5x --dur 6mo

# 自动选最长试用（默认最高档）
./auto-trial.sh

# 指定 MuMu ADB 端口
./auto-trial.sh --port 16416 --product pro --dur 3mo
```

### 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|---|---|---|
| `--list` | 只列出试用，不激活 | (激活模式) |
| `--product` | `pro` / `pro12` / `5x` / `20x` / `auto` / `g1.*` 完整 ID | `auto` |
| `--dur` | `1mo` / `3mo` / `6mo` / `12mo` / `longest` | `longest` |
| `--port` | MuMu ADB 端口 | 自动扫描 |
| `--adb` | adb 路径 | 自动检测 |

### 环境变量

| 变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `ADB_PATH` | adb 可执行文件路径 |
| `FRIDA_SCRIPT` | frida-auto-trial.js 路径（默认同目录） |
| `FRIDA_SERVER_PATH` | 设备上 frida-server 路径（默认 `/data/local/tmp/frida-server`） |
| `MODULE_APK_DEVICE` | 设备上 module.apk 路径（默认 `/data/local/tmp/module.apk`） |

| — | `g1.30tb` | 30TB | $149.99 | 无 |

App 界面"升级"按钮走的是不带试用的 ID（`g1.2tb.ai` 等）。

# sprite-stacking

An agent skill that turns four pixel art views into fake-3D sprites you can spin. By Daniel White.

![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-111?style=flat-square)
![Agent skill](https://img.shields.io/badge/agent-skill-111?style=flat-square)
![Python 3 + Pillow + NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python%203-Pillow%20%2B%20NumPy-111?style=flat-square)
![Works with](https://img.shields.io/badge/works%20with-Claude%20Code%20%C2%B7%20Codex%20%C2%B7%20Cursor%20%C2%B7%20OpenCode%20%C2%B7%20Gemini%20CLI%20%C2%B7%20Pi-111?style=flat-square)

![Six sprite-stacked assets spinning](media/showcase.gif)

## Install

```bash
npx skills add danielwh2/sprite-stacking
```

Installs to the current project. Add `-g` for every project, `-a claude-code` (or `codex`, `cursor`, ...) to pick an agent. Uses the [skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills), Node 22.20 or later.

Or copy `skills/sprite-stacking` into your agent's skills folder:

| Agent | Folder |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/` |
| Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi | `~/.agents/skills/` |

## Use

Ask your agent:

- "Make a rotatable pixel art car."
- "Sprite stack this 4-view sheet and give me a turntable."
- "Add a fake 3D pixel art tree to my Godot game."

No image generator? The agent draws the views itself in a short Python script.

## How it works

![Sheet to slices to render](media/pipeline.png)

1. **Views:** top, side, front and back, orthographic, one row.
2. **Carve:** a voxel survives only where all four views cover it.
3. **Slices:** the volume is cut into a strip of flat layers, ground first.
4. **Render:** each layer is rotated, squashed for pitch and lifted 1 px.

## Slicer CLI

```bash
python3 skills/sprite-stacking/scripts/views_to_slices.py views.png slices.png \
  --slices 36 --preview check.png --html viewer.html
```

- `--slices N`: layer count. 15-20 chunky, 32-48 detailed.
- `--order reading`: force TOP, SIDE, FRONT, BACK. Default matches views by proportion.
- `--round`: towers, balloons, pots carve round, not square.
- `--side-nose right`: the side view faces right.
- `--colours N`: shared palette size, `0` keeps every colour.
- `--normals path.png`: save a matching 3D normal-map slice strip.
- `--emissive path.png`: save an auto-detected emissive mask strip (headlights, windows, neon).

## Viewer

`--html` writes a standalone page:
- **Modes:** Turntable, **Scene** (Living Diorama with **Neon Street** and **Meadow Island** procedural stacked props, unified Y-sorting, and multi-PNG drop / `+ Add Prop`), Slice scan, Exploded view, and **Play** mode (**Drive** with WASD/arrows + drift across infinite Street/Meadow/Grid worlds, **Wind** sway, **Shatter** & rebuild).
- **Lighting & Weather:** Live **Time of Day** (Day → Sunset → Night with auto-emissive glow and ground light pools), draggable sun (`Shift+drag`) with projected 3D shadows, and **Weather** (**Rain** with pixel streaks, ground ripples, and wavy upside-down wet r…

# motlab A video engine where every scene is code, and an agent skill that writes the scenes for you. npm install -g @motlab/cli && npx @motlab/cli setup [Demo](#watch-the-demo) · [Install](#install) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Speed](#speed) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Docs](#documentation) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) [![CI](https://github.com/staryone/motlab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/staryone/motlab/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-24%2B-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](package.json)
--- Every scene is a canvas page with one function, `renderAt(t)`, that draws the frame at time `t`. motlab plays the pages in a web viewer where you step through them frame by frame, and renders them to MP4 in headless Chrome. You hand your agent a folder of references (logos, screenshots, footage, fonts, music, voice) and a direction, and it builds every scene, opens the viewer and revises from your notes. No AI image or video model is involved. The ad above (19 seconds, 7 scenes) was made with motlab and its skill, reviewed in the viewer and exported at 4K. The preview is silent; [watch it with sound](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e2ff219-697c-459f-a273-f36cb11db1d1). ## What it does - Your agent writes each scene as a canvas page, from your references and a short brief. - The viewer plays the real pages with their audio, frame by frame, with a timeline you can zoom and step through. - You point at what to change: click a frame, drag a box over a part of it, or mark a time range, and type a note on it. The agent reads every note from `selection.json` and works through them by number. - Versions of a project sit side by side in the viewer, so a second cut does not overwrite the first. - Export renders 720p, 1080p, 1440p or 4K MP4, with the scenes' transitions, music and voice mixed in. Scenes render three at a time by default (fewer on a small machine, and the Export menu lets you pick 1 to 4), which took a project of 12 short scenes from 93 to 53 s at 4K, and `"qp"` in `project.json` makes the file smaller (about 30% at `22`) when you need that. - The viewer can run on your own server behind a domain and a password, so you can review and export from your phone. - Notes are a box, a point or a pencil drawing on the frame. **Mute your Mac. Your trackpad will still talk.**

There's no speaker in a MacBook trackpad, just a small haptic motor that taps the glass so you feel a click.
NO SPEAKER drives that motor up to 4,000 times a second, fast enough to make sound you can hear, and turns it
into a voice. It talks, sings, raps, and becomes an instrument under your finger.

One command. About a minute and a half. No speakers used.

<!-- demo video: drag an .mp4 here in GitHub's editor -->

## 01 / before you start

```text
[ mute your mac ]        it still talks; that's the point
[ put it on a table ]    on your lap it's much quieter
[ hands off the glass ]  until it asks you to touch it
```

**Space** skips a part. **q** or **Ctrl-C** goes to the end.

## 02 / run it

`[ one line ]`

```sh
curl -fsSL a90.com/nospeaker | sh
```

Downloads the latest release to `~/.local/bin/nospeaker` and starts the show. `a90.com/nospeaker` points
to [play.sh](play.sh) in this repo, so you can read what it runs first.

`[ download ]`

Grab `nospeaker.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/os6/nospeaker/releases/latest),
unzip it and run `./nospeaker` in Terminal. Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

`[ from source ]`

Needs Xcode or the Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --install`). Builds one program for Apple Silicon
and Intel Macs.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/os6/nospeaker
cd nospeaker
./build.sh
./nospeaker
```

## 03 / play with it

```text
./nospeaker "hello there"            say anything
./nospeaker --voice Daniel "hello"   in another macOS voice
./nospeaker --sweep                  a rising tone, 100 Hz to 4 kHz

--dark                               white on black
--plain                              no visuals, plain text
```

## 04 / needs

A Force Touch trackpad (built into MacBooks from 2015 on, or a Magic Trackpad 2 or newer), and macOS 12 or
later on Apple Silicon, or macOS 13 or later on Intel. Without a Force Touch trackpad, it says so and exits.

```text
tested on

MacBook Pro (Mac17,10)   M5 Max   macOS 27.2.1   everything works
```

Mac, open an issue with your model, your macOS version and how it sounded.

# xnulinux

Run macOS userspace on Linux by loading the macOS kernel into it.

xnulinux builds XNU, the open-source kernel of macOS, from Apple's published sources and runs it as a loadable kernel
module (`xnu.ko`) inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel. The hosted XNU drives the CPU and MMU directly, so macOS
processes run natively next to Linux processes on the same CPUs, with no hypervisor between them. Linux lends XNU its
memory, timers, files, network and GPU through a small interface module (`fki.ko`).

With a stock Ubuntu kernel, `insmod xnu.ko` boots a macOS 27 system disk made by Apple's own installer to the
desktop: loginwindow, WindowServer, Dock, Finder, Safari and Chrome.

![macOS and Linux userspace side by side](docs/images/macos-and-linux.jpg)

*One system, two userspaces. Left: a Terminal in the hosted macOS 27.2.1 (`sw_vers`, the Darwin kernel, launchd,
WindowServer, Dock and Finder running). Right: from that macOS, an SSH session into the Linux it runs inside (Ubuntu,
Linux 7.0, the `xnu` and `fki` modules loaded, and the `insmod xnu.ko` process the macOS kernel runs in).
Straight from the hosted framebuffer, 1280×800.*

![The hosted macOS desktop](docs/images/desktop.jpg)

*The hosted desktop at the end of a 30-minute stress run, rendered on the CPU (no GPU bridge).*

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Safari on Wikipedia's XNU article](docs/images/safari-xnu.jpg) | ![Safari on kernel.org](docs/images/safari-kernel-org.jpg) |
| ![Safari on GitHub](docs/images/safari-github.jpg) | |

*Safari in the hosted macOS: Wikipedia's article on XNU, kernel.org and the Linux repository on GitHub, over the
hosted system's network link through Linux, with the GPU bridge on (`GPU=auto`).*

## How it works

```
 macOS processes (launchd, WindowServer, Safari...)    Linux processes (systemd, sshd, xnudrmd...)
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────    ────────────────────────────────────────────
 XNU (source-built, LINUX64 machine layer, kexts)  │
   ↕ linux64 host calls (xnu-patches/include/linux64_abi.h)
 xnu.ko   (APSL side: loads and runs the kernel collection)
   ↕ FKI, the foreign kernel interface (fki_*)
 fki.ko   (GPL side: CPUs, memory, faults, IPIs, files, network, host calls)
 Linux kernel (stock distro kernel, 4K pages, PAC)
```

- **CPUs**: each hosted CPU is a Linux kernel thread pinned to a Linux CPU. XNU runs on it until it calls the host
  (idle, I/O, a timer); Linux keeps its own exception vectors, and `fki.ko` forwards the faults and user exceptions of
  XNU code to XNU's handlers.
- **Memory**: XNU gets one physically contiguous block from Linux (CMA) and manages it with its own pmap; XNU and Linux
  share the user half of the address space layout (4K pages).
- **Devices**: kexts in `kexts/` give macOS a disk (a file on the Linux side), a display (a framebuffer Linux reads), a
  keyboard and pointer, an Ethernet link (a Linux network interface), a keystore and a GPU bridge.

[![validate](https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections/actions/workflows/validate.yml)

[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections)](LICENSE)

Open-source detection rules, hunting queries and indicators for security teams. They cover agentic attack frameworks: tools that hand an intrusion to AI agents, which plan, run real attack tools and keep going until they reach a goal.

Free to use under the MIT license. Fixes, false-positive reports and new indicators are welcome.

## What is here

- **Framework folders.** ARTEX and its AntiFox fork, Cairn, PentAGI, HexStrike, CyberStrikeAI, Strix, Hermes Agent, Agent Zero, RedAmon, Xalgorix and Pentest Swarm AI. Each folder is built from a review of the framework's source code and the public reporting on its use.
- **Shared behaviors.** Rules for what these frameworks have in common, whatever the tool or the model behind it.
- **Indicators and feeds.** One CSV of 572 sourced indicators, and the feeds generated from it.
- **Exposed consoles.** A dated list of addresses where one of these consoles answers on the internet, in [`exposure/`](exposure), with a [count per framework](#exposed-consoles). It is a record of what is exposed, not a detection feed.

Formats: KQL for Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, YARA and STIX 2.1, plus WAF rules for Cloudflare, AWS WAF and Azure WAF. Splunk and Elastic are covered by a Splunk app and Elastic rules for ARTEX, and by Sigma conversions for everything else.

## Try it in a minute

With Suricata installed, run the ARTEX rules over the sample capture in this repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
cd agentic-attack-detections
mkdir -p out
suricata -r frameworks/artex/tests/artex-sample.pcap -S frameworks/artex/suricata/artex.rules -l out -k none

[1:3800001:1] TD ARTEX user agent artex-<role>/1.0

The capture is test traffic written from the framework source code and published reports. It is not a recorded intrusion.

Leonida is an experimental build-it-yourself project aiming to run the Xbox Series version of Grand Theft Auto VI on Windows from a user's own copy. It does not provide a playable release.

Other languages | Status | How to build | How it works | Want to help? | Credits | License | Governance

Leonida is a static recompilation project. The Xbox Series CPU is x86-64 like a PC, so the game's code is loaded and run natively, and the console's system software is reimplemented. The console's precompiled RDNA2 GPU programs are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan. The game's models, textures and audio are read from your package. All of this happens **on your PC, from your own copy of the game**. > [!IMPORTANT] > This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You > need your own copy, with its files already readable on disk. Nothing here decrypts or works around any protection. > Everything the build creates (the generated shaders, extracted assets, the runtime folder and your saves) comes > from your game and stays on your PC. # VIctory

Runs Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series X|S) natively on Windows, from files
the user supplies.

The title's x86-64 code runs unchanged inside our process; VIctory supplies
the platform underneath it and converts the title's data, ahead of time where
it can and on first use where it must (shaders). See
[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

## Status (2026-11-23)

**Not playable yet.** The title boots, runs its menus at its own 30 fps and
loads the world, where rendering fails.

| Stage | State |
|-------|-------|
| Boot, first-boot screens (accessibility, language, settings, legal) | works, 30 fps |
| Intro video with sound | works |
| Start screen, profile and saves | works |
| Loading into the world (about 50 s) | works |
| The world (first mission's intro) | reached and runs with indirect draws; its title card renders, the scene after it is still dark; 0.5-1.8 s per frame |

Tested on one machine: Windows 11, AMD RX 6700 XT.

> **Warning.** Entering the world on a real GPU can currently hang it, and
> Windows then resets the display driver (every monitor goes black for a
> moment). To look further, use a diagnostics build with
> `VICTORY_D3D12_WARP=1`, which renders on the software adapter.

What each part does today and what it still needs:

| Subsystem | Today | Needs |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Loader | Runs the title's executable and its DLLs in our process; crash reports name the faulting code and are kept in `crashes.log` | – |
| Runtime services | One signed-in offline user, licences, packages, saves that survive a kill at any step, text entry dialog | Speech is silent; the dialog and relaunch are untested live |
| Network | Offline by design: the title cannot reach the network | – |
| Files and streaming | Archives and streamed data read, zlib and BCPack decoded in parallel | Loading is limited by writes into title memory |
| Input | XInput pads, keyboard, keyboard stand-in pad | Trigger rumble |
| Audio | Menu, video and loading sound; XMA voices and Opus streams decode | Reverb is silent; Opus results unverified against the title |
| GPU: menus | Draws, compute and presentation on host D3D12; only changed title memory is copied | Frame pacing drifts on one screen in release builds |

# XCL – Xbox Series X|S → Windows compatibility layer

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20the%20server-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xcl)
**Discord: <https://discord.gg/xcl>**

XCL is a compatibility layer that runs Xbox Series X|S (GDK) games you own on a Windows PC - in the spirit of Wine/Proton. There is no CPU emulation: the game's x64 code runs natively, and XCL provides its own, independently written implementations of the console system libraries the PC does not have (`kernelx.dll`, XGameRuntime, `d3d12_xs.dll`, …). The console's GPU code (RDNA2 machine code) is recompiled into PC shaders (HLSL → DXIL).

XCL works only on unpacked game files you already own. It does not download, decrypt or unpack game packages (XVC / MSIXVC) and contains nothing for circumventing DRM. The repository holds no code, headers or binaries from the console SDK, no keys and no game data; the Windows components XCL relies on (XGameRuntime, XAudio2, D3D12, DXC) come from your own system or the public Windows SDK and are not distributed with XCL.

# PortWatch VI

**Does GTA VI run on PC yet?** A static GitHub Pages site that tracks every serious community effort to recompile, emulate or port the leaked Xbox Series build of GTA VI to PC. All efforts are scored on one ladder, and a scout refreshes the data every 3 hours.

- One headline progress bar shows the closest effort, with the top projects pinned to it.
- A live countdown runs to the missing executable's expected drop.
- A leaderboard card per effort shows its own bar, milestone ladder, groundwork breakdown, what works and what's blocking.
- Further sections cover the watchlist of early projects, a toolkit of asset tools, the scout's inbox of new candidates, and fake-download warnings.

No game files, keys or executables are hosted or linked, ever.

## Deploy on GitHub Pages

1. Create a new GitHub repository and push this folder to its `main` branch.
2. In the repo, open **Settings → Pages** and set **Source** to **GitHub Actions**.
3. Open **Settings → Actions → General** and make sure workflows are allowed.
4. Open **Actions → Scout → Run workflow** to run the first scout. It commits fresh data and deploys the site.

Each deploy also runs `scripts/build-site.mjs`, which turns `data/tracker.json` into pages search engines can read: one page per news story (`news/<id>.html`), a news archive, an RSS feed (`news/feed.xml`) and `sitemap.xml`. It then pings [IndexNow](https://www.indexnow.org/) (Bing, Yandex and others; no account needed) with the URLs that changed since the last deploy. For Google, add the site in Search Console and submit `sitemap.xml`.

From then on, `Scout` runs every 3 hours (00:17, 03:17, 06:17 … UTC) on GitHub's servers, so no computer of yours needs to be on. Any push to `main` redeploys the site through `Deploy site`. To change the frequency, edit the `cron` line in `.github/workflows/scout.yml`. For example, `17 6 * * *` runs it once a day. GitHub can delay scheduled runs by a few minutes when it's busy.

## What the scout does (`scripts/scout.mjs`)

1. **Refreshes** every tracked repo: stars, forks, issues, last push, commits in the last 7 days, and whether it's gone (404, or 451 for a DMCA block). It also hashes each README to notice changes.
2. **Spots claims.** If a README newly says GTA VI boots, reaches the menu or runs at some FPS, the card shows an "unverified claim" banner and the change feed records it.
3. **Discovers** new repos from GitHub and GitLab searches (`scout.queries` in `data/tracker.json`), Hacker News, Bluesky, Mastodon, Lemmy and 4chan, plus Reddit and X when keys are set, by pulling GitHub links out of posts. It also gathers **headlines** from the Google News and Bing News feeds, keeping only stories about the leak, ports, takedowns, scams or official news. And it **watches GitHub's public DMCA log** for new Take-Two or Rockstar notices, flagging any tracked project they name. On 4chan it uses the free read-only API, at one request per second. [![slop](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fdeterministic-machines%2Fdeslop-please%2Fbadges%2Fslop.json)](https://github.com/deterministic-machines/deslop-please/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
